reasoning_input.question_text: Find the point of intersection between the line r = (1, 2, -1) + t(2, -1, 3) and the plane 2x + y - z = 9.

student_steps.content: Parametric form of line: x = 1 + 2t, y = 2 - t, z = -1 + 3t
5 = 9 is impossible. Therefore the line is parallel to the plane and does not intersect.

reasoning_input.final_answer: No point of intersection (line is parallel to plane)

steps.description: Write line equations in parametric form x(t), y(t), z(t)
Substitute parametric coordinates into plane equation 2x + y - z = 9
Expand and simplify coefficient of t
Recognize that dot product of direction vector and normal vector is zero (2·2 + 1(-1) + (-1)3 = 0)
Conclude correctly that line is parallel to plane with no intersection
